subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should the GOMAXPROCS 2/8 race sweep with five repetitions run on every push and pull request, or live in scheduled/manual stress CI?
rationale: Functional review establishes that the workflow works, but cannot determine the repository's acceptable ongoing CI latency, cost, and flake budget.

options.title: Schedule the full sweep
options.body: Retain ordinary per-change race coverage and run the full 2×5 stress matrix on a schedule or manual dispatch.

options.title: Accept always-on stress
options.body: Merge the workflow as written because the additional scheduling coverage outweighs its recurring Actions cost and latency.

options.title: Use a lighter PR sweep
options.body: Run fewer repetitions on pull requests and reserve all five repetitions for scheduled stress runs.

recommendation.title: Schedule the full sweep
recommendation.body: Retain ordinary per-change race coverage and run the full 2×5 stress matrix on a schedule or manual dispatch.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository-wide CI cadence choice is best routed to the available project-ownership candidate.
